exercises.why: **чте́ние** — reading (the process of interpreting written language). Wiktionary: читать + -е́ние.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: reading (the process of interpreting written language)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: сказа́ние — legend; saga; story; ви́дение — vision, sight; сиде́ние — sitting; чте́ние — reading (the process of interpreting written language).
**проше́ние** — petition, application (a verbal or written request). Wiktionary: проси́ть + -е́ние.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: petition, application (a verbal or written request)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: проше́ние — petition, application (a verbal or written request); жела́ние — wish, desire; писа́ние — writing, script, scripture; положе́ние — position, location.
**молча́ние** — silence (action or state of remaining silent; that is, abstention from speech, utterances, or the use of the voice). Wiktionary: молча́ть + -а́ние.
